truth_description: Ben, clearing his late father's boxes, finds the bundle of blackmail letters from Owen. He reads them twice, hands shaking, then sends Priya a message cancelling their evening plan.
Owen is at the pub, drinking steadily. He is in a dark mood — a business deal fell through today.
player_description: Owen Price is at the pub, on his third pint.

truth_description: Nadia, in her flat above the clinic, glances out the window before drawing the curtains. She notices Ben crossing the square — unusual to see him at this hour.
player_description: From an upstairs window, a light is on above the clinic — someone briefly parts the curtain and looks down at the square.

truth_description: Ben reaches the fountain and waits. He has the blackmail bundle in his jacket pocket. He sits on the fountain rim in the dark.
Owen pays his tab and leaves. Fred notices he is walking straight enough.
player_description: Owen Price pays and leaves the pub at about ten to eleven.

truth_description: Fred catches up to Owen near the fountain. They argue briefly but intensely about Fred's massive unpaid debts and Owen's extortion. Fred drops his engraved lighter in the mud. He leaves Owen alive.
Fred storms back into the pub, locking the door behind him.
Elias, unable to sleep, sits by his bedroom window. He sees two figures near the fountain — one sitting on the rim, one arriving from the pub direction.
player_description: A light is on in the cottage facing the fountain. A silhouette moves at the window.

truth_description: Ben shows Owen the letters. Owen smirks — 'your dad came to me, not the other way round. He wanted protecting.' He is contemptuous and shows no remorse. Ben's voice rises.
player_description: From the direction of the fountain, two voices — a younger and an older. The older sounds dismissive.

truth_description: Owen turns away, laughing. Ben seizes the loose coping stone from the fountain rim and strikes. Owen falls without crying out. Ben stands with the stone in his hand for a long moment, then drops it.
Ben walks quickly back across the square toward his flat. His right cuff is smeared with mud from the flower bed. He stepped in it when he seized the stone.
player_description: A figure walks fast across the square from the direction of the fountain and disappears.

truth_description: Elias, unable to sleep, looks out his bedroom window. He notices a dark shape slumped against the fountain base. He goes down to investigate and finds Owen.
player_description: Elias Grant looks from his window, goes down to the square, and stops in shock. Owen Price is collapsed beside the fountain. The stone coping lies nearby.
